title: The start checks come back after a session start: load brake first, then the model floor and the handoff-unread check
why:
Owner "a" at 01:43 CST Nov 15 (relayed by the consultant; ruling own-3381-a, owner item 865): PR 3381 merges as is, and the three checks it drops at PreToolUse come back some other way. Coordinator 01:45 CST: lane start-checks-after-call (get_session read by triage 01:45 CST: connected, parent the coordinator, tag cs-step:start-checks-after-call). Order: the load brake on a start first, then the model floor and the handoff-unread check. No start_session name goes back into a PreToolUse matcher (that matcher makes the app show the card on every start, even in Bypass: anthropics/claude-code#103832). The lane waits on the 3381 merge to build. Debts start-session-load-unbraked and start-session-checks-after stay open until this merges. Route is open: the owner named none; a check that does not sit in the PreToolUse matcher is the one constraint.

Triage 08:21 CST Nov 15 (coordinator 08:20 CST, relayed; GitHub REST read by triage 08:21 CST): the merge this lane waited on has landed, via #3501 (replaced #3381, closed unmerged), merged at 08:18:20 CST. The lane is not started by this line; whether and when it builds is the coordinator's order.

08:25 CST Nov 15 (coordinator 08:24 CST, relayed; triage read no lane state): lane session_013NEJKzvNSpeqiQVskuCLsv is told to build now (plan check against main first, draft PR, merges nothing). The real wait, the #3381 change, is lifted (#3501 merged 08:18:20 CST). The coordinator read #3477 as not the hold (it is a closed combine PR, see wave-plan Queue now); this step carries the real wait.

COORDINATOR'S PICK 08:39 CST Nov 15 (undoable, not the owner's; relayed; on the lane's round 1 finding, which triage did not read): the lane's SessionStart stop also stops the owner's own new session at full load, which the lane reads as breaking the owner's rule in decision machine-load-brake; the owner override cannot lift it. The coordinator told the lane option (a): the hook flags instead of stops (additionalContext; a lane reads its tags and stops itself), and the same for the model-floor stop. Lose: a model can ignore a flag; debt start-session-load-unbraked stays open. Departs from: main stops Agent/Task/Workflow starts at full; this flags a local startup. The lane builds against (a) and merges nothing meanwhile.

TRIAGE JUDGEMENT 08:41 CST Nov 15: no owner item. Triage's read of decision machine-load-brake on main (GitHub, 08:41 CST): its bullet 'The orchestrator is never braked on its own shell or writes' says a coordinator, triage or batch-runner session carries no lane tag and is not braked, 'It is the session that frees the disk, so a recovery does not depend on the full disk it recovers'. That bullet is about shell and file writes by an orchestrator; the owner's phrase in the coordinator's message ('the session that frees the disk is never braked') is a paraphrase, not a quote. Same decision, 'Not covered: start_session': main has NO brake on a start_session call (no PreToolUse hook sees it; debt start-session-load-unbraked; nothing replaces the read). So the stop this follow-up adds is the lane's own new one, and flagging instead of stopping does not loosen any stop main has today. Owner ruling own-3381-a already accepted that the load brake on a start is gone until this follow-up lands. An owner item only if a reviewer finds a stop on main loosened.

UNMEASURED, NO COMMAND (coordinator 08:43 CST Nov 15, relayed from the lane's reply; supersedes the 08:41 CST owner-test wording): the lane gave no exact command for either unknown, and both are unmeasured. With the coordinator's flag pick, unknown (1) becomes: does the app deliver SessionStart additionalContext to a session made by start_session. Unknown (2), does a start_session session run its startup SessionStart hook at all, is unchanged. A pass would be a lane started at a staged full-load or Haiku state that shows the flag text in its first turn. Evidence so far comes only from the installed CLI 2.1.42 (a non-interactive session skips the startup hook), not from the desktop app. No owner item is posted: a task item needs its command in the item's command field, and there is none.

NOTE 08:44 CST Nov 15 (the coordinator's own slip, relayed 08:44 CST; low, one slip): the coordinator relayed 'never braked' as the owner's rule without reading decision machine-load-brake (the lane's paraphrase). Guard idea, not built: read the cited decision before passing on a quoted rule. Triage's call: a note, not a debt (one slip, no repeat). The lane was told to quote the decision's own sentence in its PR body and in its Departs from line.

08:48 CST Nov 15 (coordinator 08:48 CST): second slip in the hour of the same kind (a pick from a rule's paraphrase or a different repo's grant, without reading the decision that governs the case): home #731, where the coordinator picked from the claude-settings 'Lane draft PR' grant and runner 11 found owner ruling Q2 in draft-until-reviewed. The pick was withdrawn 08:48 CST. Step read-decision-before-pick.
